text: Leading a healthy life involves more than just avoiding illness; it’s about caring for your whole self. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the fuel it needs. Regular exercise, like brisk walking or cycling, strengthens your heart and boosts your mood. Equally important is getting enough sleep—aim for seven to nine hours each night to recharge your mind and body. However, true health also includes mental well-being. Taking time to relax, practicing mindfulness, or simply talking to a friend can reduce stress. Finally, strive for a good work-life balance by setting boundaries and making time for hobbies. Remember, small, consistent changes lead to lasting results.
